user_saw: On macOS, setup detection could fail to read saved credentials when OpenClaw ran on the app’s bundled Bun.
summary: The fix passes the selected SQLite library path to read-only subprocesses on macOS Bun, including launches with a limited environment.
reasoning: The updated auth test reproduces the missing handoff by giving the child only OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR, and the older worker diff shows that caller-supplied environments predated the macOS app’s bundled Bun Gateway. PR #169111 later switched setup detection from synchronous credential reads to the async reader, but the available history does not establish when macOS setup first supplied an environment that omitted the SQLite library path.
